# Microsoft Copilot Studio What's New — captured 2026-08-10
# https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/whats-new
# ms.date 2026-07-15, updated_at 2026-08-03

Newest "Notable changes" section is still **June 2026** — IDENTICAL to the 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-09
captures. No July or August 2026 section has been published.

June 2026 (all reported 2026-08-07): new agent experience / GitHub Copilot harness
(production-ready preview); Microsoft IQ; skills; memory; Windows 365 for Agents MCP server (GA);
condition groups; voice agents with Teams Phone Agent (preview); connect other agents (preview);
Foundry IQ knowledge connection (preview); Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.5 Chat as primary model (GA).

Released versions page (power-platform/released-versions/copilotstudio, updated_at 2026-07-01):
still tops at platform 2026.6.3 / UX 26.06.21-24 (June 30, 2026) — unchanged, and now ~6 weeks
stale relative to the What's New page. Regional spread: preview/France/Switzerland/Korea/Germany/
South Africa/Norway/Canada/India/Sweden/South America on 2026.6.3; UK/Asia/UAE/Japan/Europe on
2026.6.2; Australia/US/GCC on 2026.6.1.

NOTE (cross-reference, 2026-08-10): Copilot Studio agents now appear in the tenant-wide
**Entra ID -> Agent ID -> All agent identities** inventory alongside Foundry agents, and in the
**Microsoft Agent 365 registry**. See azure-ai-foundry_changelog.txt for the Agent 365 recovery
reported 2026-08-10 — it changes how Copilot Studio agents are discoverable, without any change to
this page.

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change.
